correctness.rationale: On each mode r=1−x² the update is F_a(r)=1−(1−r)(1+r/2+ar²)². Differentiation gives its sole positive interior minimum for a>3/8 at r_*=(8a−3)/(10a). At that point (1−r_*)(1+r_*/2+ar_*²)²=(16a−1)²(2a+3)³/(25000a³). Independent polynomial multiplication checked that subtracting 12500a²(2a+1) from the numerator gives (4a+1)²P(a); P(3/8)=−1125/4, P(29/20)<0<P(3/2), and convexity plus positive derivative at 29/20 isolate the relevant root. For 0<r<1 the factorization of F_a−r gives strict descent, and the positive Bernstein expression at a=3/2, together with monotonicity in a, gives F_a>−r below the cap. On the negative side r=−t, 0<t≤1/(2a_*), the multiplier is strictly between 0 and 1 for a≤U<a_*, giving F_a(−t)>−t; its upper bound F_0(−t)=t²(3−t)/4<t gives strict contraction there too. The image of the positive side stays above −1/(2a_*) by the minimum calculation, so a compact invariant interval provides a uniform contraction factor for each fixed input and cap. Writing X_k=J B_k with J=A(A²)^(−1/2) and positive B_k commuting with J handles even the nonnormal square case; in the rectangular case use the initial polar isometry in place of J. This preserves branches and makes the spectral residual norm the maximum of the modal magnitudes. At equality r_* maps to the negative fixed point −1/(2a_*); above equality the same initial-minimum construction crosses the fixed-point barrier, after which the magnitude strictly increases and cannot have a finite limit. Direct rational replay gives F_{3/2}(3/5)=1−(2/5)(46/25)²=−1107/3125<−1/3.
